title: Approved HEP Contract
description: The formal, controlled boundary between K9-REHAB-PRO (clinical control plane) and B.E.A.U. Home (home execution plane). Emitted by protocol-store.handoffToBeau(). Only an APPROVED protocol version may produce one. B.E.A.U. receives the exact approved prescription and cannot alter it.

protocol_version_number.description: B.E.A.U. must key its local state on this. A new version supersedes the previous handoff.

effective_date.description: Timestamp of clinician approval — the moment the recommendation became a prescription.

frequency.description: Protocol-level session frequency, e.g. '2x/week'. NOT the same as an exercise's own frequency.

exercise_code.description: Canonical code from the K9 exercise library. B.E.A.U. must treat this as the identity of the prescribed movement and must not substitute a different exercise.

origin.description: ENGINE means the exercise passed every K9 safety gate. CLINICIAN means a clinician added it by hand, bypassing those gates on their own authority. B.E.A.U. should surface the distinction rather than hide it.

frequency.description: This exercise's own dosing frequency, e.g. '2-3x/day'. Distinct from the protocol-level frequency above; collapsing the two loses the prescription.

dosage_override.description: Clinician-specified dosage. When present it takes precedence over sets/reps/frequency/duration above, which are retained so the change stays visible.

equipment.description: What the exercise requires. This is the input B.E.A.U. computes household substitutions against — substitution must preserve the movement objective, never change the prescription.

red_flags.description: Stop conditions for an unsupervised home session. B.E.A.U. must present these to the owner and halt the exercise when one is observed.

selection_reason.description: Why this exercise was shortlisted for the home program. Ranking narrows what the engine already permitted; it never adds an exercise or changes a dosage.

active_safety_gates.description: Which K9 safety gates fired for this patient. B.E.A.U. must NOT re-derive or re-evaluate these — clinical reasoning stays in K9 — but needs them to refuse unsafe household substitutions. Example: with _severeOA active, no substitution may reintroduce impact loading.

approver_role.description: Always a clinician-class role. Technicians and owners cannot approve.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical content of the approved version. B.E.A.U. should store it: it identifies exactly which clinical content was authorized, and distinguishes a genuine revision from a corrupted or replayed payload.

approval_basis.description: How the approver held authority. LICENSURE = an attending veterinarian. CREDENTIAL = a rehabilitation practitioner with a current CCRP/CCRT. ADMINISTRATIVE = an admin override, deliberately distinguishable from a clinical approval.

approver_credential.description: The credential relied upon, e.g. CCRP. Null for a veterinarian approving by licensure with no licence record on file.

home_environment.description: The home the adaptation permissions are about, read from the clinician's record. Null means nothing has been recorded — which is NOT a record with empty fields, and does not narrow what B.E.A.U. may do. This is context, not a constraint: nothing here gates exercise selection.

stated.description: Verbatim, as the clinician recorded it. The record itself.

normalized.description: This codebase's single reading of the stated values, so B.E.A.U. never string-matches a clinical vocabulary itself. A sub-reading is null where the phrase was not understood.

uninterpreted.description: Fields that were stated but could not be read. Reported rather than dropped, because an unreadable home fact is a gap in the record and must look like one.

goals.description: What success looks like, split by who each goal was written for — not withheld from either. Each goal carries its horizon, target date and review status, so B.E.A.U. can show an owner what has already been achieved rather than an undifferentiated list. Null means no goals recorded. Context, not constraint: the engine has no patient-goal input. Practice admin, such as the client's communication preference, is deliberately excluded.

primary_goals.description: The selected rehabilitation goals, in the order the clinician chose them. Each carries the stated label and its code, so nothing downstream matches on the prose.

code.description: Null where the label is not in the vocabulary — expected, since 'Other' invites free text. The goal still travels.

owner_facing.description: Goals written in what the dog will be able to do, plus the owner's own words and priorities.

goal.description: The goal, in the clinician's or owner's own words.

target_date.description: Set by a clinician, never parsed from the goal text. Null means nobody has said when — which is not the same as no deadline mattering.

status.description: Null means UNREVIEWED — nobody has looked at this goal yet. That is deliberately NOT 'in progress'.

overdue.description: Derived from target_date and status on read, never stored. Null when there is no target date, which is 'nobody said when' rather than 'on time'.

clinical.description: Goals written in clinician measures — ROM in degrees, HCPI thresholds, thigh girth. Carried so the record is whole, but not addressed to the owner as instructions.

goal.description: The goal, in the clinician's or owner's own words.

target_date.description: Set by a clinician, never parsed from the goal text. Null means nobody has said when — which is not the same as no deadline mattering.

status.description: Null means UNREVIEWED — nobody has looked at this goal yet. That is deliberately NOT 'in progress'.

overdue.description: Derived from target_date and status on read, never stored. Null when there is no target date, which is 'nobody said when' rather than 'on time'.

uninterpreted.description: Primary goals whose label is not in the vocabulary. Reported so a consumer does not mistake a free-text goal for one that failed to match a code.

beau_permissions.description: The explicit authority boundary, transmitted with every handoff so it is never assumed. B.E.A.U. adapts EXECUTION; it never generates or alters a PRESCRIPTION.

clinic_protocol.description: Clinic-delivered work the veterinarian has prescribed for the CCRT/CCRP to perform in practice — Class IV laser, NMES, underwater treadmill. Carried so B.E.A.U. can show the owner what happens at their appointment. It must NEVER be presented as something to attempt at home.

venue_reason.description: Why it cannot be done at home.
